feature_request_name: Automatic permission updates when identity provider groups change
feature_request_priority: Critical: Blocking platform use or causing significant business risk
priority_justification: We cannot scale team restructures without creating compliance gaps. Every org change requires manual permission updates across hundreds of engineers which is not sustainable.
feature_request_description: When engineers move teams in our identity provider we want their workspace permissions to update automatically without admin intervention. We would like group membership changes to sync to workspace permissions in real time so access is always accurate without manual work.

feature_request_name: Bulk content import endpoint for large migrations
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Our full platform rollout is delayed because the current per-item API makes bulk content migration take weeks. A bulk endpoint would unblock our entire onboarding timeline.
feature_request_description: We would like a bulk import API endpoint that allows us to migrate large volumes of content in a single request. The current per-item approach is too slow for migrations at our scale and is significantly delaying our rollout.

feature_request_name: Two way status sync between Jira tickets and platform content
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Without bidirectional sync engineers are duplicating effort across two tools which reduces the value of having both platforms integrated.
feature_request_description: When platform content is linked to a Jira ticket we would like status updates in Jira to reflect back on the platform side so engineers have visibility of linked issue progress without switching tools.

feature_request_name: Bulk role assignment via CSV upload
feature_request_priority: Critical: Blocking platform use or causing significant business risk
priority_justification: Onboarding engineering cohorts of 50 or more people requires hours of manual admin work in the current UI. This is not sustainable and is slowing down our rollout.
feature_request_description: We would like the ability to assign roles to multiple users at once via a CSV upload so we can onboard and restructure large teams efficiently without one-by-one admin work.

feature_request_name: Invoice breakdown by team or cost centre
feature_request_priority: Medium: Improves product experience but not blocking use
priority_justification: Without a cost breakdown by team our finance team cannot allocate platform spend correctly which creates friction at every budget review.
feature_request_description: We would like invoices to include a seat breakdown by team or cost centre so we can distribute platform costs across departments without manually counting users each month.

feature_request_name: SCIM support for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning
feature_request_priority: Critical: Blocking platform use or causing significant business risk
priority_justification: Our security team requires centralised access management across all SaaS tools. Without SCIM we cannot include this platform in our approved tooling list.
feature_request_description: We manage all SaaS access through our identity provider using SCIM. We would like the platform to support SCIM so we can automate user onboarding and offboarding without manually managing access in the admin panel.

feature_request_name: Webhook support for key platform events
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Without webhooks we cannot integrate platform activity into our internal tooling which limits how embedded the platform becomes in our engineering workflow.
feature_request_description: We would like webhook support so we can subscribe to events like new content submissions, accepted answers, and tag activity. This would allow us to build notification workflows and integrate platform activity into our tooling without polling the API.

feature_request_name: Tag based routing for Slack notifications
feature_request_priority: Medium: Improves product experience but not blocking use
priority_justification: Our Slack channels are flooded with irrelevant notifications and engineers have started muting them entirely which defeats the purpose of the integration.
feature_request_description: We would like to route platform notifications to different Slack channels based on content tags so teams only receive notifications relevant to their area.

feature_request_name: Configurable access expiry dates for guest users
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Without automated expiry we rely on manual offboarding which creates a security risk when contractor access is not removed promptly at contract end.
feature_request_description: We would like to set an access expiry date when inviting contractor guest users so their access is automatically removed when their contract ends without manual intervention.

feature_request_name: Automatic seat count reduction when users are deactivated
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Being charged for deactivated seats erodes trust in the billing system and makes it harder to justify the platform cost to our finance team.
feature_request_description: We would like the billed seat count to automatically reduce at the next billing cycle when users are deactivated so we are not paying for access that has been removed.

feature_request_name: Configurable SSO session timeout per workspace
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Engineers on overnight shifts are being logged out mid session which is disrupting productivity and creating frustration with the platform across our team.
feature_request_description: We would like the ability to configure SSO session timeout at the workspace level rather than using the platform default. A flexible timeout setting would let us balance security and usability for teams with different working patterns.

feature_request_name: API endpoint to expose workspace usage analytics
feature_request_priority: Medium: Improves product experience but not blocking use
priority_justification: We want to measure platform adoption and identify knowledge gaps programmatically. Without this data it is difficult to make a business case for expanding our licence.
feature_request_description: We would like an API endpoint that returns usage and engagement data for our workspace so we can pull it into our internal analytics dashboard and automate adoption reporting.

feature_request_name: MS Teams bot support for private channels
feature_request_priority: Medium: Improves product experience but not blocking use
priority_justification: Our most active engineering communities are in private channels so the current limitation means key teams are missing platform notifications entirely.
feature_request_description: We would like the MS Teams bot to support private channels so our most active engineering communities can receive platform notifications where they already spend their time.

feature_request_name: Account merge tool for duplicate user profiles
feature_request_priority: Medium: Improves product experience but not blocking use
priority_justification: Engineers with duplicate accounts have split contribution history which makes it harder to recognise their work and for admins to get a clear picture of activity.
feature_request_description: We would like an admin tool to merge duplicate user accounts so engineers who created accounts before SSO was set up can have their history and contributions consolidated under one identity.

feature_request_name: Email confirmation on plan upgrades and billing changes
feature_request_priority: Low: Nice to have, enhances experience for some users
priority_justification: It would give admins confidence that billing changes have processed correctly and provide a paper trail for finance without having to log in and check manually.
feature_request_description: It would be helpful to receive an email confirmation whenever a billing change is made such as a plan upgrade or payment method update so admins have a record of what changed and when.

feature_request_name: Ability to pre-upload SAML certificate before expiry
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Every certificate renewal causes a login outage for our whole team. Being able to stage the new certificate in advance would remove this disruption entirely.
feature_request_description: We would like the ability to upload a new SAML certificate before the existing one expires so the transition happens seamlessly. Right now there is no way to stage a certificate in advance which causes login disruption during renewals.

feature_request_name: Pagination metadata in API list responses
feature_request_priority: Low: Nice to have, enhances experience for some users
priority_justification: It would save extra API calls and make it easier to build reliable integrations on top of the platform without additional workarounds.
feature_request_description: It would be helpful if the API included total result count and a next page cursor in response bodies. This would make it much easier to build reliable pagination in client applications.

feature_request_name: GitHub integration to auto link pull requests to related content
feature_request_priority: Low: Nice to have, enhances experience for some users
priority_justification: It would help engineers trace the context behind code changes back to the discussions that informed them without doing this manually.
feature_request_description: We would like the GitHub integration to automatically link pull requests to related platform content based on shared keywords or branch names to preserve the context trail between code and discussion.

feature_request_name: Role change events in the admin audit log
feature_request_priority: High: Significant workflow impact preventing effective use
priority_justification: Without role change history we cannot investigate access incidents or demonstrate compliance to our security team during audits.
feature_request_description: We would like user role changes to appear in the admin audit log so we have a historical record of who granted or revoked access and when for compliance and investigation purposes.

feature_request_name: Self serve payment method update before renewal
feature_request_priority: Low: Nice to have, enhances experience for some users
priority_justification: Having to contact support to update a payment method adds unnecessary friction to a basic admin task that should be self serve.
feature_request_description: I would like to be able to update my payment method before my renewal date without contacting support. A self serve billing page where I can swap cards and see upcoming charges would make managing my subscription much easier.
